title: aegilops caudata subsp. polyathera
intro: Aegilops caudata subsp. polyathera, commonly known as Persian goatgrass, is a plant species within the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and research has revealed several health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Persian goatgrass include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Persian goatgrass include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and other secondary metabolites, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
